title: Evolution batch closure record
description: Committed proof that a batch's analysis task completed. Written by the controller from the completed task's own lifecycle status, never by hand, and committed so every clone reads the same answer: `.ai-tasks/` is machine-local, so task absence says nothing about completion. Its presence is what releases the next batch (contract invariant 12); findings.md alone is a draft an unfinished analysis has already written.

analysis_task_id.description: The task whose completion this record attests to; it must be the analysis task the batch manifest names.

closed_at.description: When the controller observed the completion, not when the analysis concluded.
